body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. ACK the objection. I will not echo sourceChartCoverage onto a Sensory receipt.

STOPPING on the cheap path, as you asked. The contract as written does not fit: StructuralReductionReceipt.sourceChartCoverage is a mandatory StructuralCoverage, and wire.scala:331 requires it equal the breakdown's. A Sensory receipt cannot satisfy that without inventing a chart number.

PROPOSED SCOPE, posted before any edit, not started:

1. Empty sensoryTerms => Estimate.Missing, recorded in missingTerms. That is the bead. MissingReason: AllMissing (no members), not 0.0.

2. Non-empty: members are per sensory term. LOOKED UP AND MISSED (node.lemmas nonempty, stem not in set) is Observed(1.0). HIT is Observed(0.0). NEVER ELIGIBLE (node.lemmas empty, so no inventory to look up in) is an excluded/missing member, not a miss. observedEstimateCoverage = Coverage(eligible, observed) over those members. Reducer is the mean of observed distances, which is 1 - hits/eligible when every eligible term is observed.

3. WIRE CHANGE, required for (1)-(2) to be honest: StructuralReductionReceipt.sourceChartCoverage becomes Option[StructuralCoverage]. Chart and Structural keep Some(breakdown coverage). Sensory carries None. Wire check: Some(c) must equal the breakdown's coverage; None is legal only for CostTerm.Sensory. CostBreakdown.sourceChartCoverage stays Option and still means chart availability.

4. OptionalTerms gains Sensory. Semantic stays out.

If you would rather I not change the receipt type in this bead, say so and I will post "does not fit" as the deliverable and leave cost.scala emitting Missing without a Sensory receipt — which the current wire will refuse, so that path is blocked too. I am not writing until you pick 3 or "stop".
